messages:
nina: Quick sync 1 1 1  0: were scheduling a tiered dependency mitigation dry-run next Wed 08:30 PT. Objective: validate our layered fallback (local cache -> alt-registry -> read-only snapshot) and vendor escalation chain for auth and model-registry failures. Need clear owners + timeline.

devon: I can own the vendor escalation play and contact list. I'll verify primary account rep & emergency contacts are up-to-date and rehearse the phone/escalation steps.

rachel: I'll take the registry-side execution: snapshot publishing, promo alias switch, and client-side URL rotation logic. Will prepare a small test model and a deterministic hash check so we can assert reads hit the fallback.

tom: I'll handle infra: network route manipulation, NAT gateway failover, and an S3 replication sanity check. Also will verify that logs for the critical services are ingested to our incident bucket for 7d retention.

infra-bot: Alert: scheduled maintenance window placeholder created for Wed 08:00-09:30 PT. Please update with actual drill steps.

nina: Thanks. A few non-negotiables to include in runbook:
- escalate to vendor-account if internal failover not achieved within 90s
- preserve original request IDs and capture full KV-cache dumps before we flip aliases
- do not rotate live tokens during the test window unless explicitly marked as a test token

devon: Action items I've got:
- Vendor contact verification + escalation script (owner: devon)  due Tue 18:00 PT
- Short vendor dry-run script for account rep (owner: devon)  run Wed 08:45 PT during drill

rachel: Registry items:
- Publish snapshot and verify integrity hash (owner: rachel)  due Tue 20:00 PT
- Endpoint alias swap playbook + canary (owner: rachel)  due Wed 07:30 PT (pre-drill smoke)


tom: Infra items:
- Route failover plan + terraform patch (owner: tom)  due Tue 16:00 PT
- Logging retention check + S3 replication smoke (owner: tom)  due Tue 19:00 PT

nina: Security note: Rachel/Tom, confirm replication encryption headers and that replication copies strip any ephemeral creds. We must avoid PII in the snapshot.

rachel: Will add a filter step in the snapshot pipeline. Hashes only contain model weights + metadata tags, we will strip any inference logs.

vendor-bot: Vendor escalation channel ready: account-team@vendor.example.com, duty@vendor.example.com; incident code: VID-2026-03. Autoresponder enabled.

nina: Acceptance criteria for drill (short):
- app requests seamlessly served from fallback model-registry within 2 minutes for 95% of canary traffic
- auth token renewal flows do not return 401s during fallback window
- vendor contact engaged within 5 minutes if internal mitigations fail
- drill runbook updated + post-drill notes + actions created in tracker within 48h

devon: I'll add a quick spreadsheet for vendor engagement steps and a checklist to the incident board.

tom: Quick smoke commands for the runbook (copyable):
```
# verify registry fallback
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer test-token" https://staging.api.redwood/v1/model/mini/health | jq .status
python tools/check_aliasing.py --target alt-registry --verify-hash abc123
```

rachel: Canary snippet for model integrity check (will PR):
```
{"canary":true, "model_id":"mini", "verify_hash":"abc123", "route": "5%->alt,95%->primary"}
```

nina: oncall-bot please schedule the drill and set a 30m prebrief. Also create a follow-up issue template for the postmortem so action items are standardized.

oncall-bot: Scheduled: Tiered dependency mitigation dry-run  Wed 08:30 PT. Reminder set 30m prior. Follow-up issue template created at /incidents/templates/vendor-dryrun.

devon: One concern: weve seen a recurring pattern where auth issuer latency spikes coincide with model-registry metadata pushes (approx every 5-7 weeks). During postmortem we should consider a coordinated change window with vendor or add a quiesce step to registry publishes. Marking as potential recurring pattern.

nina: Good call. Call that out in the post-drill notes and tag product/vendor. If the pattern holds, we escalate to a joint runbook and consider throttling metadata writes.

rachel: PR opened for canary + snapshot filter. Marking registry tasks as in-progress.

tom: Route failover terraform PR linked, tests passing. Logging retention verified. Marking infra items as done — will post results in this thread once I run the smoke.

devon: Vendor contact list updated. Will rehearse escalation script with account rep Tue EOD.

nina: Perfect. After the drill, everyone: paste a 1-line outcome + any regression indicators here. We'll assemble a short postmortem doc and assign owners for follow-ups within 48h. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
